scope: Godot single-thread wasm32 release Web template for offline gameplay; no audio/font/resource compression changes. Current profile disables WebSocket; the previously accepted compiled template has not been rebuilt.

flags.rationale: Standard module defaults plus concrete audited blacklist; no all-modules-off whitelist or per-class pruning.
Retain default Web -Os. Source explicitly avoids -Oz for its small saving/runtime cost. Builder owns LTO/toolchain.
Keep 3D scene/resources/rendering/camera/mesh/light behavior.
Keep RichTextLabel, ColorPickerButton and FileDialog for chat/scoreboard/settings/menus.
Keep 3D server/nodes and GodotPhysics3D; only alternate Jolt is removed.
Compatibility/WebGL2 is the accepted renderer.
Keep JS bridge eval/interfaces/callbacks/buffer conversion for input/uploads/saving/fullscreen.
ZIPReader/ZIPPacker contract; zip module can_build requires this flag.
Remove only unused 2D physics server/nodes; Control/Canvas rendering stays.
No Godot 2D navigation consumers.
Bots query project VoxelData via TdmVoxelNavigation, not engine navigation.
No XR server, nodes, VR/WebXR camera or pose contract.
No CSG nodes/authoring. GLTF declares this dependency optional and guards its adapters; uploaded static GLBs reject node extensions.
VoxelData/chunk ArrayMesh owns world data/rendering/collision; no GridMap. Its GLTF adapter is optional and guarded.
Built-in models are imported to PackedScene. Runtime uploaded models must be .glb; FBX/ufbx is outside that contract.
Project has no physics-engine override. Exact GodotPhysics3D registration sets the default; Jolt only registers an alternate. GodotPhysics3D stays enabled.
World creates ConcavePolygonShape3D faces directly; no convex-decomposition call. Uploaded GLBs are static meshes, reject required/node extensions and have no physics import contract.
All project shaders are ordinary Shader/ShaderMaterial with .gdshader source. No VisualShader graph resources are loaded or accepted in uploaded packs.
Offline gameplay has no ENet UDP or high-level transport consumers.
Offline gameplay has no WebRTC peer or data-channel transport consumers.
Offline gameplay has no UPnP discovery or port-mapping consumers.

No JSONRPC game/probe consumers. GDScript lists it as an optional dependency solely for LSP; exact gdscript/SCsub compiles language_server only for env.editor_build. Web also defines GDSCRIPT_NO_LSP. Core JSON parsing remains available independently.

No SceneMultiplayer/RPC/MultiplayerSpawner/MultiplayerSynchronizer or high-level multiplayer consumers. Offline local simulation owns all actor state. SceneTree still receives a valid core MultiplayerAPIExtension from create_default_interface when the module default is unset. Its empty poll returns OK, unique ID defaults to 1, and it has no peer list. Core MultiplayerPeer/MultiplayerAPI remain engine interfaces.
All 295 active PNG texture import descriptors use compress/mode=0 (lossless). No Basis assets. Uploaded textures and embedded GLB images must be PNG.
No KTX/KTX2 assets/uploads. KTX requires BasisUniversal; both are removed together. PNG/GLB contracts remain supported.
No BMP assets/runtime decoding; uploaded textures require PNG.
No DDS container assets/uploads. Keep bcdec/etcpak/astcenc for generic compressed-texture fallback; this removes only the DDS file loader.
No Radiance HDR image-file assets/uploads. Floating-point shader/render-target presentation uses core Image formats independently.
No TGA assets/uploads; uploaded textures require PNG.
No OpenEXR assets/uploads. HDR render targets use core Image formats. Removed Basis encoder had an editor-only dependency on TinyEXR.
Sound catalog is Ogg Vorbis or curated WAV PCM. Uploaded sound resources require Ogg Vorbis; no MP3/MP1/MP2 path.
No video playback/video pack resources. Ogg and Vorbis remain independently enabled.
No AudioStreamInteractive/Playlist/Synchronized resources or music graphs. Core WAV/AudioStreamPlayer and Ogg Vorbis remain available.
All game logic is typed GDScript, with runtime load() of trusted first/third-person skin scripts.
Default server, CharacterBody3D, terrain concave collision, shapes and 3D ray/collision queries.
Resource-pack decoder constructs GLTFDocument/GLTFState, appends bytes and generates a scene; static scene-only pruning would miss it.
Runtime ZIPReader uploads plus exported-probe ZIPPacker. Requires minizip=True.
planar_reflection.gd constructs RegEx at runtime.
Multiplayer, game/map transport and the socket echo probe are removed. The offline runtime has no WebSocket consumers; disable this module in the next custom-template rebuild.
openspades_effects.gd constructs FastNoiseLite; disabling it would break this script.
Vorbis mandatory dependency and runtime packet-sequence resources.
Original sound catalog and uploaded overrides use AudioStreamOggVorbis.load_from_buffer.
Retain lossless image/imported CTEX decode hooks and optional SVG image support.
Conservatively retain SVG/GLTF optional image hooks and generic JPEG support; no savings claimed.
Retain advanced text optional support and theme/vector graphics behavior.
Dynamic AlteDIN1451 TTF and engine default fonts, including allow_system_fallback=true.
Preserve default advanced text/font stack rather than simplifying font modes.
Full multilingual shaping/layout, ICU/HarfBuzz/Graphite, CJK line breaks, original Japanese/Korean/Chinese and player text.
Retain general native/core TLS, cryptography and certificates. Removing multiplayer does not establish that these engine APIs are unused; the conservative profile keeps them.
Runtime GLTF produces ImporterMesh/ArrayMesh; preserve its procedural mesh optimization hooks.
No 2D collision/body physics. Core flag removes the server/nodes; Control/Canvas and 2D rendering stay enabled.
No Godot NavigationServer2D/agent consumers; core flag removes navigation nodes/server.
New TDM bots use TdmVoxelNavigation: bounded VoxelData queries, Dictionary stand-column graph and explicit clearance; no Godot NavigationServer3D.
Ordinary Camera3D game; no VR pose/tracking/interface. Core disable_xr also removes XR nodes/server.
No XR contract; OpenXR already cannot_build on Web, so this explicit flag is documentary with no extra baseline Web saving.
No WebXR interface/pose/camera contract; core disable_xr removes XR nodes/server.

module_inventory_method: Executed exact config.can_build with Web release options and is_enabled defaults. Mandatory dependencies reviewed separately; this is expected static inventory, not compile/browser acceptance. The offline update changes only WebSocket from explicit keep to explicit remove; these counts describe the next profile build, not the existing compiled binary.
protected_contracts: full advanced GUI and bitmap/TrueType/CJK text
dynamic attributed ZIP packs and trusted skin factories
WAV PCM and Ogg Vorbis playback
limits: No extra savings claimed for features already disabled by standard Web release configuration.
Additional accepted image/audio/model formats or physics/extensions/script resource-pack contracts require re-audit.
Static audit does not establish runtime rendering/input/audio/performance/physical-device/full-port acceptance.
Actual compiled module header, export and browser-probe results belong to coordinator build evidence.

The disabled high-level multiplayer module leaves SceneTree with the core MultiplayerAPIExtension fallback. Rebuilt-template actual-scene initialization remains required; no socket roundtrip is an offline acceptance requirement.
The accepted compiled custom binary still contains WebSocket until rebuilt from the new offline profile. No binary-size or performance improvement is claimed by this source audit.

offline_scope_update.compiled_template_status: The existing accepted custom Web binary still includes the WebSocket engine module. This source-profile update has not been compiled. A later custom-template rebuild and actual-scene/browser checks must adopt the new profile; offline game code no longer uses WebSocket.
